summary: CyanBridge 2.4.1 is a fix-up release for 2.4.0. It adds Google Play's required 16 KB memory page size support and the new "Answer only my voice" option. Recommended installation: Google Play For most users, the recommended way to install and update CyanBridge is through Google Play: Download CyanBridge from Google Play Google Play provides the simplest update path, automatic updates, and Play Protect checks. Availability of version 2.4.1 may follow the configured Play rollout. The APKs attached below are for users who specifically need direct sideloading. The AAB is for Play Console and testing tracks and cannot be installed directly. What's new Google Play compatibility: 16 KB memory pages Google Play rejected 2.4.0 because three native libraries were built for 4 KB memory pages: the LibVLC video engine ( libvlc.so , libvlcjni.so , used for EyeVue live preview) and the LC3 audio codec ( liblc3.so , used by Mentra glasses).
